Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: When opening the Eldon, Missouri page, WebSurfer surfaced and implicitly trusted incorrect on-page signals indicating “Cole County” without resolving the contradiction against the page’s metadata (which said Miller County) or cross-checking authoritative sources. This introduced a wrong county (Cole) into the workflow and, in subsequent steps, WebSurfer failed to follow instructions to corroborate the county with reliable sources (e.g., ignoring a result explicitly stating “Eldon Genealogy (in Miller County, Missouri)”), leading to ambiguity and risking an incorrect final answer instead of the correct Miller County.
